item.tib: snyan rgyud sgron ma gzer bu dang bcas pa'i 'chad thabs
item.coloph: de ltar rdzogs pa chen po zhang zhung snyan rgyud kyi sgron ma drug gi sa bcad 'di/ gzhung lugs smra ba'i phyug tshang bya bral la/ sde snod 'dzin pa'i drang srong nam rgyal sogs/ don gnyer can gyi slob mas bskul ba'i ngor/ gnas chen kha rag rdo sku'i ri khrod du sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
